gain_definition: Calibrated minus selected population rare excess half loss.
interpretation: Descriptive per-run finite-family selection gains, conditional on frozen calibration choices. Exact-selection mean gains combine theoretical finite-family adaptation gains with calibration suboptimality; the latter is zero only when calibration chooses the true expected-risk minimum, as in the baseline. The theorem optimizes deterministic rates and stops, not adaptive selection.

error_definition.rare_mean_prediction: Mean signed prediction error over two rare cells.
